Your being admitted or not will solely depend on whether you meet all entry requirements.1. ApplicationSubmit your application and pay the admission fee within the application deadline. Once we receive payment of the admission fee, your file officially enters the evaluation process.2. Academic EvaluationYour application is now being examined with regard to two different aspects:your academic background, i.e. whether you meet the qualification requirements for the Master’s degree in question.This aspect is assessed by the Academic Board, which is made up of university professors who will be teaching on the programme. your language skills, i.e. whether you meet the applicable language proficiency requirements, if any.Depending on the programme for which you applied, this aspect may be assessed either by the Academic Board or the University Language Centre (SLAM).The Academic Evaluation may take some time, especially when many applications are being assessed at the same time or when additional steps (such as interviews or tests) are required. Don’t worry, it’s all part of the process!Please don’t contact us for updates on your application. We will be the ones contacting you if we need you to submit additional documents or information.3. Credentials EvaluationIf you pass the Academic Evaluation, the next step is a formal verification of your academic credentials. This means that we check that your qualification:makes you eligible to enrol in a Master’s degree in Italywas issued by a legitimate and officially recognised higher education institution.The duration of this phase may vary, depending on how clear your documents are, how many applications are being processed, and how easy it is to retrieve information on institutions and qualifications.4. Admission & EnrolmentIf you pass the Credentials Evaluation stage, congratulations — you have officially been admitted!Follow the instructions provided in the admission notice to complete enrolment and officially begin your Master’s journey.Remember: your enrolment will remain conditional until you submit all required documents and we fully verify their authenticity. Select your category EU or EU-equivalent with foreign qualification Choose this category if: you are a citizen of a European Union (EU) member state, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, or San Marino; you are a non-EU citizen with a valid Italian residence card (or residence permit application receipt); you have dual citizenship, including one from a EU country non-EU residing abroad with foreign qualification (visa app) Choose this category if you are not a citizen of a European Union (EU) member state, you reside abroad, and you will apply for an Italian student visa Marco Polo Choose this category if you have a Chinese citizenship and you are part of the Marco Polo programme Why do we ask this? Certain steps in the application process, such as applicable deadlines, application form questions or other tasks may depend on the category you choose here.
